import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    
    n = int(data[0])
    q = int(data[1])
    
    arr = list(map(int, data[2:2+n]))
    
    queries = []
    idx = 2 + n
    for i in range(q):
        t = int(data[idx])
        x = int(data[idx+1])
        y = int(data[idx+2])
        queries.append((t, x, y))
        idx += 3
    
    # Fenwick Tree implementation
    # Tree is 1-indexed internally
    # Tree[i] = sum of elements from index (i - lsb(i)) to (i - 1) in 0-indexed array
    # where lsb(i) = i & (-i)
    
    class FenwickTree:
        def __init__(self, size):
            self.n = size
            self.tree = [0] * (self.n + 1)
        
        def update(self, index, delta):
            # index is 0-based
            i = index + 1  # convert to 1-indexed
            while i <= self.n:
                self.tree[i] += delta
                i += i & (-i)
        
        def prefix_sum(self, index):
            # returns sum of elements from 0 to index (inclusive), 0-based
            # index can be -1, which returns 0
            if index < 0:
                return 0
            i = index + 1  # convert to 1-indexed
            result = 0
            while i > 0:
                result += self.tree[i]
                i -= i & (-i)
            return result
        
        def range_sum(self, l, r):
            # sum of elements from l to r (inclusive), 0-based
            return self.prefix_sum(r) - self.prefix_sum(l - 1)
    
    ft = FenwickTree(n)
    
    # Initialize the Fenwick tree with the initial array
    for i in range(n):
        ft.update(i, arr[i])
    
    for query in queries:
        t = query[0]
        x = query[1]
        y = query[2]
        
        if t == 1:
            # Update: set arr[x] = y
            delta = y - arr[x]
            arr[x] = y
            ft.update(x, delta)
        else:
            # Query: sum from x to y (inclusive)
            result = ft.range_sum(x, y)
            print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
